== Summary ==
Games at a long table. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Camera timestamp:''' 2021:10:09 17:51:31 (EXIF; camera clock not verified)
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-20
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brandon Baity]] ("Here are most of the pictures I took during the weekend", forum post 1356914)
* '''Image:''' native forum attachment, rotated upright losslessly to 2584×4592 from the 4592×2584 camera file (EXIF orientation applied, metadata removed; replaced an earlier 2400 px copy on 22 November 2026).
